usedFor: Slide order events like “When an order is fulfilled” save files into Dropbox with “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “When an order is fulfilled” in Slide, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Fulfilled orders trigger it, and the action saves a file from a public web link to a chosen folder.

watchOut: “Delete File or Folder” empties a whole folder, so keep it off broad triggers like “When a contact is updated”.
